verdict.rationale: Community users confirm that Logseq keeps data locally as Markdown files they can sync via GitHub, and describe it as intended to be offline-first. Exports to standard Markdown, OPML and JSON add a further ownership path. The main caveat is the new DB version, which users say means data can no longer be kept as plain Markdown files, and the generated Markdown also has formatting quirks that hurt compatibility with other tools. Missing for 10: first-party docs on local file storage and offline operation, a plain-file guarantee in the DB version, Markdown that other apps read cleanly, and hands-on confirmation that everything works fully offline.
